integrity: The complete classification is supported by an analytic proof with a sharp boundary and a standalone supplementary checker. No independence or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Real normalized coefficient triples (1,a,b) and the canonical unweighted half-plane Riesz Gram kernel only; not complex coefficients, longer sequences, a fixed-w slice count, or arbitrary domains.
title: Sharp real three-jet Lu Qi-Keng phase for the upper-half-plane Bergman Gram kernel
